name: Anderson University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university affiliated with the Church of God (Anderson, Indiana), founded 1917. Approximately 1,057 undergraduates (College Scorecard) with 60+ undergraduate majors across six schools. Overall admission rate ~79% (College Scorecard).
financial_aid: Published tuition ~$37,240/yr; total cost of attendance ~$51,585/yr (College Scorecard, IPEDS 150066). Average net price for private-aid students ~$25,021. Pell grant recipient rate ~36%; federal loan rate ~58%. As an NCAA Division III institution, no athletic scholarships are awarded; aid is need- and merit-based academic aid.
facilities_notes: Softball competes on campus at Anderson University; program plays in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference. Specific field/facility details not confirmed from a public athletics facilities page during research (2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference (HCAC). Head coach Tony Holloway is a long-tenured leader (17th year as head coach and 40th year at Anderson University as of the 2023-24 season per his athletics bio).
notes: Softball coaches directory (https://athletics.anderson.edu/sports/sball/coaches/index) checked 2026-07 and lists only one softball-specific coach: Head Coach Tony Holloway. No assistant coaches, recruiting coordinators, or graduate/volunteer assistants were publicly listed at time of research. Roster_size = 19 reflects the most recently completed 2025-26 roster; the upcoming 2026-27 roster page currently lists 11 players (partial/in-progress). NCAA D3 = no athletic scholarships, so scholarship_count is null. Tuition and aid figures sourced from the U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard (IPEDS 150066) because anderson.edu cost pages blocked automated fetching.
